name: Why do my drains keep clogging?

mainEntity.name: Why do my drains keep clogging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recurring drain clogs are often caused by a buildup of hair, grease, soap scum, or foreign objects. Persistent issues might indicate a deeper problem such as tree root intrusion into pipes, damaged or collapsed pipes, or improper pipe installation causing poor drainage. Identifying the root cause is essential for a lasting solution.
